channel.desc: The story of an orphaned girl named Elnara, who lives alone with her older sister, Resti. For the sake of Nara's dream of becoming a nurse, Resti works hard. Until finally Resti betrothed with Verdi who is rich. Nara is very happy because Resti's marriage has made their lives better, but in an instant Nara's happiness disappears.
